Parse the openFDA Drugs@FDA and NDC Directory Downloads

Source: R/openfda_parser.R
parseOpenFDA.Rd

Reads openFDA's bulk download files for Drugs@FDA (drug/drugsfda) and the NDC directory (drug/ndc) and returns a dvobject with one table per record level, field names as in the files.

Usage

parseOpenFDA(
  drugsfda_path = NULL,
  ndc_path = NULL,
  release = NULL,
  release_date = NULL,
  retrieved_at = NULL
)

Arguments

drugsfda_path

Character or NULL. Path to the Drugs@FDA download (zip or JSON).

ndc_path

Character or NULL. Path to the NDC directory download (zip or JSON).

release

Character or NULL. Release label, e.g. "2026-10".

release_date

Date, "YYYY-MM-DD" or NULL. Release date; by default the files' export date.

retrieved_at

Date, "YYYY-MM-DD" or NULL. Date the files were downloaded.

Value

A dvobject with tibbles. From Drugs@FDA: drugsfda_application (key application_number), drugsfda_product (key application and product_number), drugsfda_active_ingredient, drugsfda_submission (key application, submission_type and submission_number), drugsfda_submission_property_type, drugsfda_application_doc and drugsfda_openfda. From the NDC directory: ndc_product (key product_id), ndc_active_ingredient, ndc_route, ndc_pharm_class, ndc_packaging and ndc_openfda. Only the tables of the files given are built.

Details

Each download is one JSON object, {meta, results}, usually zipped (drug-drugsfda-0001-of-0001.json.zip, drug-ndc-0001-of-0001.json.zip). Zips are read directly, without extracting them to disk; an unzipped .json file works too. The parser checks the number of records against meta.results.total.

Drugs@FDA lists FDA application products (NDA, ANDA, BLA); the NDC directory lists products registered for sale, including products sold under an OTC monograph without an application. Every application, product, submission and listing is kept as the files have it, including tentative approvals (submission_status "TA"); the parser does no status grouping and no matching across sources.

YYYYMMDD dates become dates. NDC packaging dates are written two ways (20220525 and 04-DEC-09) and are kept as text, as written. finished and sample are logical. Every other field stays text. The openfda block of each record is kept as (key, field, value) rows; it is openFDA's annotation, and it can belong to another drug (for example ANDA202111).

release_date defaults to the files' meta.last_updated (the export date) when every file given has the same one.

Parsing the full Drugs@FDA and NDC files takes about a minute and needs roughly 300 MB of memory.

openFDA data are released under CC0 1.0. openFDA asks for credit, which is recorded in the object's metadata (see get_source_metadata), and states: "Do not rely on openFDA to make decisions regarding medical care."

See also

Other parsers: cett_nodes_options(), drug_node_options(), parseDrugBank(), parseHGNC(), parseHPO(), parseHealthCanadaDPD(), parseOnSIDES(), parseTWOSIDES(), references_node_options()

Examples

openfda_dir <- system.file("extdata", "openfda", package = "dbparser")
openfda <- parseOpenFDA(
  drugsfda_path = file.path(openfda_dir,
                            "drug-drugsfda-0001-of-0001.json.zip"),
  ndc_path      = file.path(openfda_dir, "drug-ndc-0001-of-0001.json.zip"),
  release       = "2026-10")
#> Parsing openFDA Drugs@FDA...
#> Parsing openFDA NDC directory...
#> Parsed 9 Drugs@FDA applications and 9 NDC listings.
openfda$drugsfda_product[, c("application_number", "brand_name",
                             "marketing_status")]
#> # A tibble: 21 × 3
#>    application_number brand_name                           marketing_status
#>    <chr>              <chr>                                <chr>           
#>  1 ANDA076219         MIRTAZAPINE                          Prescription    
#>  2 ANDA076219         MIRTAZAPINE                          Prescription    
#>  3 ANDA076219         MIRTAZAPINE                          Prescription    
#>  4 ANDA076220         OFLOXACIN                            Discontinued    
#>  5 ANDA076220         OFLOXACIN                            Discontinued    
#>  6 ANDA076220         OFLOXACIN                            Discontinued    
#>  7 NDA007245          AEROLONE                             Discontinued    
#>  8 ANDA085638         CODEINE, ASPIRIN, APAP FORMULA NO. 4 Discontinued    
#>  9 BLA018780          HUMULIN R PEN                        Over-the-counter
#> 10 BLA018780          HUMULIN R                            Over-the-counter
#> # ℹ 11 more rows
get_source_metadata(openfda)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 12
#>   metadata_version source  source_name         release release_date retrieved_at
#>   <chr>            <chr>   <chr>               <chr>   <date>       <date>      
#> 1 1                openfda openFDA (U.S. Food… 2026-10 2026-10-20   NA          
#> # ℹ 6 more variables: source_url <chr>, licence <chr>, licence_url <chr>,
#> #   attribution <chr>, files <list>, parser <chr>
